---
title: "Outbreak Trends in Toronto Healthcare Institutions"
author: "Yuying Fan"
output: html_document
---

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
library(tidyverse)

# load all outbreak csv files
files <- list.files(pattern = "ob_report_.*csv")

# combine into one dataframe
df <- bind_rows(lapply(files, read_csv))

# convert date column
df$`Date Outbreak Began` <- as.Date(df$`Date Outbreak Began`)

# count outbreaks per month
monthly <- df %>%
  mutate(month = format(`Date Outbreak Began`, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  count(month)

# plot
ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Healthcare Outbreaks (Toronto, 2016–2025)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Outbreaks"
  )
